title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Kriging
text: autoSTK provides automatic spatio-temporal Kriging inspired automap (Hiemstra et al. 2010). extends automap workflow spatio-temporal variogram fitting, Kriging prediction, cross-validation common R spatio-temporal data classes.

title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Kriging
text: installing, make sure core spatial dependencies available: gstat, spacetime, sp, sf, sftime, automap. cubble package suggested required working directly cubble_df objects.
code: remotes::install_github("sigmafelix/autoSTK")

title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Kriging
text: Automatic spatio-temporal variogram fitting autofitVariogramST(). Automatic spatio-temporal Kriging autoKrigeST(). Explicit fit/predict workflow fitVariogramST() predictKrigeST(). Cross-validation autoKrigeST.cv() using spatial, temporal, spatio-temporal, random folds. Support STFDF, STSDF, STIDF, sftime, cubble inputs main fitting prediction workflow. Conversion helper cubble_to_sftime() nested temporal cubble objects. Multiple spatio-temporal variogram structures, including sumMetric, metric, productSum, separable. Multiple optimizers, including lbfgsb, grid, sa, ga.

title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Kriging
text: autofitVariogramST(): automatically fits spatio-temporal variogram. fitVariogramST(): fits variogram returns reusable STVariogramFit object. predictKrigeST(): predicts fitted STVariogramFit object. autoKrigeST(): fits variogram predicts one call. autoKrigeST.cv(): cross-validates spatio-temporal Kriging results. cubble_to_sftime(): converts cubble_df objects sftime.

title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Kriging
text: main Kriging workflow accepts legacy spacetime classes modern simple-feature classes: Internally, autoSTK converts modern inputs spacetime classes required gstat::variogramST() gstat::krigeST().

what: Forecast Air Quality From Station Networks
title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Kriging
text: Use autoKrigeST() repeated measurements monitoring stations want predictions future spatio-temporal grid. classic STFDF/STSDF workflow.
code: library(autoSTK) library(gstat) library(sp) library(spacetime) library(stars)  data(air)  deair <- STFDF(stations, dates, data.frame(PM10 = as.vector(air))) deair_sf <- st_as_stars(deair) |>   st_transform("+proj=longlat +ellps=sphere") |>   st_transform(3857)  deair_r <- as(deair_sf, "STFDF") deair_r@sp@proj4string <- CRS(   "+proj=merc +a=6378137 +b=6378137 +lat_ts=0 +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +k=1 +units=m +nadgrids=@null +wktext +no_defs +type=crs" )  deair_rs <- deair_r[, 3701:3800] deair_rss <- as(deair_rs, "STSDF")  akst_stk <- autoKrigeST(   formula = PM10 ~ 1,   input_data = deair_rss,   cutoff = 300000,   width = 30000,   type_stv = "sumMetric",   model = c("Exc", "Mat", "Ste", "Exp", "Wav"),   tlags = 0:7,   cores = 8,   optimizer = "sa",   verbose = TRUE )  akst_stk_stars <- st_as_stars(akst_stk$krige_output) plot(akst_stk_stars[1, ])

title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Kriging
text: Use sftime data already lives sf-style workflow one geometry column one time column. autoKrigeST() accepts sftime training data prediction data. fitVariogramST() predictKrigeST() useful want reuse fitted variogram across several prediction grids.
code: library(autoSTK) library(sf) library(sftime)  # station_long has columns: #   id, time, PM10, geometry # where geometry is an sfc_POINT column and time is Date/POSIXct. station_sf <- st_as_sf(   station_long,   sf_column_name = "geometry",   crs = 3857 )  station_st <- st_as_sftime(   station_sf,   time_column_name = "time",   sf_column_name = "geometry" )  fit <- fitVariogramST(   formula = PM10 ~ 1,   data = station_st,   typestv = "sumMetric",   candidate_model = c("Sph", "Exp", "Gau", "Ste"),   cutoff = 300000,   width = 30000,   tlags = 0:7 )  pred <- predictKrigeST(   fit = fit,   data = station_st,   newdata = prediction_grid_st,   formula = PM10 ~ 1,   nmax = 40 )

title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Kriging
text: Use cubble workflow stores station metadata spatial face repeated measurements temporal face. autoSTK can convert either nested temporal face sftime. can also pass cubble_df directly main Kriging workflow supplying prediction grid: cross-validation, convert cubble sftime data spacetime object first, autoKrigeST.cv() builds folds @sp @time slots.
code: library(autoSTK) library(cubble)  # cb is a cubble_df created from an sf object with station geometries and a # temporal table containing PM10 observations. pm10_st <- cubble_to_sftime(cb, time_col = "time", key_col = "id")  akst_cb <- autoKrigeST(   formula = PM10 ~ 1,   input_data = pm10_st,   cutoff = 300000,   width = 30000,   tlags = 0:7,   type_stv = "sumMetric" ) akst_cb <- autoKrigeST(   formula = PM10 ~ 1,   input_data = cb,   new_data = prediction_grid_st,   cutoff = 300000,   width = 30000,   tlags = 0:7 ) pm10_stfdf <- as(as(pm10_st, "STIDF"), "STFDF")  akst_cv_cb <- autoKrigeST.cv(   formula = PM10 ~ 1,   data = pm10_stfdf,   nfold = 3,   fold_dim = "temporal",   cutoff = 300000,   width = 30000,   tlags = 0:7 )

title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Kriging
text: autoKrigeST.cv() evaluates prediction performance holding different parts spatio-temporal data set. result data frame one row per fold: columns : CVFold: fold identifier. RMSE: root mean squared prediction error. MAE: mean absolute prediction error. BIAS: mean prediction minus mean observed value. Summarise cross-validation results compare model settings: Lower RMSE MAE indicate smaller prediction errors. BIAS values close zero indicate little systematic - -prediction. fold_dim = "spacetime", nfold must perfect square, 4, 9, 16, folds built spatial groups crossed temporal groups.
code: akst_cv_t <- autoKrigeST.cv(   formula = PM10 ~ 1,   data = deair_rs,   nfold = 3,   fold_dim = "temporal",   cutoff = 300000,   width = 30000,   tlags = 0:7,   cores = 8,   optimizer = "sa" )  akst_cv_s <- autoKrigeST.cv(   formula = PM10 ~ 1,   data = deair_rs,   nfold = 3,   fold_dim = "spatial",   cutoff = 300000,   width = 30000,   tlags = 0:7,   cores = 8 )  akst_cv_spt <- autoKrigeST.cv(   formula = PM10 ~ 1,   data = deair_rs,   nfold = 4,   fold_dim = "spacetime",   cutoff = 300000,   width = 30000,   tlags = 0:7,   cores = 8 ) akst_cv_t #>   CVFold     RMSE      MAE      BIAS #> 1      1  ... #> 2      2  ... #> 3      3  ... summary_cv <- data.frame(   fold_dim = "temporal",   mean_RMSE = mean(akst_cv_t$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),   mean_MAE = mean(akst_cv_t$MAE, na.rm = TRUE),   mean_BIAS = mean(akst_cv_t$BIAS, na.rm = TRUE) )  summary_cv

title: Cross-validation of spatiotemporal Kriging — autoKrigeST.cv
text: data `STFDF`-class object fold_dim character. dimension want cross-validate (spatial, temporal, random) nfold integer. number folds. 10 default formula formula. e.g., y~1 type_stv character. One 'sumMetric', 'metric', 'productSum', 'separable' block numeric. passed conduct block spatiotemporal Kriging. model character vector. Default c("Sph", "Exp", "Gau", "Ste"), users can specify list theoretical variograms referring gstat::vgm. kappa numeric vector. Kappa values tested Matern-family variogram models. fix.values numeric vector. Initial values order nugget, range, sill, respectively. tlags integer vector (increasing, preferably consecutive). temporal lags. cutoff numeric. maximum distance sample variogram computed. width numeric. interval variogram cloud summarized. nmax integer positive infinite. maximum number spatiotemporal neighbors conduct local spatiotemporal Kriging. aniso_method character. One 'vgm', 'linear', 'range', 'metric'. Please refer ?gstat::estiStAni. type_joint character. model form joint spatiotemporal variogram. prodsum_k numeric. parameter case 'productSum' chosen type_stv. surface logical. TRUE, also return variogram surface fitting path. start_vals numeric vector (3). initial values optimize spatiotemporal variogram model. miscFitOptions list. See ?automap::autofitVariogram. measurement_error numeric vector length 3: spatial, temporal, joint measurement error terms. cores integer. number threads used compute sample spatiotemporal variogram. seed integer. Random seed fold generation. variogram_from_full logical. TRUE, fit one ST variogram full data reuse across folds. optimizer character. Optimization method passed ST variogram fitting. objective character. Objective ST variogram fitting ('WLS' 'MLE'). n_restart integer. Number restarts optimizer = 'lbfgsb'. optimizer_control list. Extra control options forwarded selected optimizer.

title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Variogram Fitting — autofitVariogramST
text: stf spatio-temporal data frame (STFDF, STSDF, STIDF, sftime). formula formula specifying response explanatory variables. typestv Character. ST variogram model type. One "sumMetric", "separable", "productSum", "productSumOld", "simpleSumMetric", "metric". candidate_model Character vector candidate spatial/temporal variogram model families (e.g. c("Ste", "Exc", "Exp", "Wav")). guess_nugget Optional initial guess nugget. Estimated NULL. guess_psill Optional initial guess partial sill. Estimated NULL. tlags Integer vector temporal lags. cutoff Numeric. Maximum spatial lag distance. width Numeric. Width spatial lag bins. aniso_method Character. Method estimating ST anisotropy ratio ("vgm" "linear"). type_joint Character. Model family joint variogram component. prodsum_k Numeric. k parameter productSum models. surface Logical. TRUE, also compute return variogram surface. measurement_error Numeric vector length 3: spatial, temporal, joint. cores Integer. Number cores variogramST. verbose Logical. TRUE, print diagnostic messages. optimizer Character. Optimisation strategy: "lbfgsb" (default - multi-start L-BFGS-B), "grid" (LHS grid search + L-BFGS-B refinement), "sa" (simulated annealing via optim(method = "SANN")), "ga" (genetic algorithm via GA package). objective Character. Fitting criterion: "WLS" (weighted least squares, default) "MLE" (Gaussian log-likelihood; n < 500). n_restart Integer. Number optimisation restarts optimizer = "lbfgsb".  Default 1 matches v1.x behaviour. optimizer_control Named list extra arguments forwarded optimiser.  Recognised keys differ optimiser: "lbfgsb" maxit (default 2500). "grid" n_coarse (default 50), n_refine (default 30),     maxit (default 2500). "sa" maxit (default 5000), temp (initial temperature,     default 10), tmax (steps cooling, default 10). "ga" popSize (default 50), maxiter (default 200),     run (early-stopping generations without improvement,     default 30), seed (default 42).

title: Automatic Spatio-Temporal Variogram Fitting — autofitVariogramST
text: STVariogramFit object (list) elements: jointSTV Fitted ST variogram model. empSTV Empirical ST variogram. SpV Fitted spatial marginal variogram. TV Fitted temporal marginal variogram. STVsurface (Optional) Variogram surface surface = TRUE. optimizer Character. Optimiser used. objective Character. Objective function used. loglik Numeric. Log-likelihood (objective = "MLE"). n_obs Integer. Number observations (AIC/BIC).

what: Simulated Annealing Optimiser for ST Variogram Fitting — .optimize_stv_sa
title: Simulated Annealing Optimiser for ST Variogram Fitting — .optimize_stv_sa
text: Uses stats::optim(method = "SANN") globally search WLS objective surface vgmST model, refines best solution short L-BFGS-B run.  Parameters transformed unconstrained space via scaled logistic map SANN can explore freely without explicit boundary enforcement.

title: Estimate Initial ST Variogram Parameters from Empirical Data — estimate_initial_params
text: Nugget — median \(\gamma\) first decile     spatial lags (extrapolation toward zero-lag). Sill — 95th percentile \(\gamma\) values     spatial lags minimum time lag (spatial marginal plateau). Spatial practical range — smallest spatial lag     spatial marginal exceeds 95% estimated sill; falls back     50% maximum spatial lag variogram never reaches     sill within sampling window. Temporal practical range — rule applied     temporal marginal minimum spatial lag.
